mapper.select: SELECT id FROM public.accounts WHERE username = #{username}

SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.staff_member_id, a.patient_id, a.username, a.password_hash, a.status, a.account_type, s.status AS staff_status FROM public.accounts a LEFT JOIN public.staff_members s ON s.id = a.staff_member_id WHERE a.username = #{username}

SELECT r.id AS role_id, r.code AS role_code, ar.granted_by, ar.granted_at, p.code AS permission_code FROM public.account_roles ar JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = ar.role_id LEFT JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ar.account_id = #{accountId} AND r.active = true ORDER BY r.id, p.code

SELECT a.id FROM public.accounts a WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ((a.account_type = 'STAFF' AND a.patient_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_members s WHERE s.id = a.staff_member_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE')) OR (a.account_type = 'PATIENT' AND a.patient_id IS NOT NULL AND a.staff_member_id IS NULL)) FOR UPDATE OF a
